summary_md: **Robert Krajewski ([@rob_krajewski](https://x.com/rob_krajewski/status/2115903551566479747))** built **heappi**, which runs the whole Pi harness (including code mode) in a snapshotable QuickJS heap, snapshotting on any await so it can wait days without RAM and resume in 4–25 ms, with the heap stored incrementally in SQLite or S3 ([topos-sh/heappi](https://github.com/topos-sh/heappi); inspirations: [dquickts](https://github.com/stencil-hq/dquickts), [infinity](https://github.com/hydro-project/infinity), [pi durable](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/tree/main/packages/durable), [celld](https://github.com/denoland/celld)).
